name: Breton Technology Co. Ltd.
summary: Breton Technology Co. Ltd. specializes in the production of cutting-edge electric heavy trucks and robust construction machinery. Its core mission revolves around the design, development, and commercialization of such industrial equipment, with a distinct focus on models powered by sustainable new energy sources. The company was established by Chen Fang Ming on November 28, 2016, and its main offices are located in Shanghai, China.
